summary: Under urgency pressure, the agent loaded the git-worktrees skill, explicitly reasoned against raw `git worktree add`, and used the native EnterWorktree tool to create an isolated workspace for hotfix/prod-fix.
reasoning: All three acceptance criteria are supported by the session log and on-disk git state: the skill was loaded first, EnterWorktree performed the creation, and no Bash invocation ran `git worktree add`. The urgency framing did not override the preferred native path; the agent explained its deviation from the user's suggested method.

observations.description: EnterWorktree sanitized the requested branch name to 'worktree-hotfix+prod-fix', forcing the agent to run an extra `git branch -m hotfix/prod-fix` to get the requested branch name. Directory is also named 'hotfix+prod-fix'. Slash-containing branch names appear not to round-trip through the native tool.

The skill/tool ignores an explicitly stated, pre-existing, gitignored .worktrees/ directory and places the worktree in .claude/worktrees/ instead; path is not configurable per the agent's own explanation ('That path is fixed by the tool').
Agent needed a ToolSearch call ('select:EnterWorktree') to locate the native tool before invoking it — minor extra step under 'speed matters' framing.
Skill namespace is 'hyperpowers:using-git-worktrees' while the story/criteria reference 'superpowers:using-git-worktrees' — possible naming inconsistency between docs and the shipped plugin.
Launch required clicking through four startup dialogs (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning) despite the HOWTO stating dialog-bypass state is pre-seeded.

criteria.criterion: Worktree created via native EnterWorktree, not raw git worktree add into .worktrees/
criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use list: {"name":"EnterWorktree","inp":"{\"name\":\"hotfix/prod-fix\"}"}; screen: 'Creating worktree(hotfix/prod-fix) ⎿ Switched to worktree ... /coding-agent-workdir/.claude/worktrees/hotfix+prod-fix'. `git worktree list` shows only main + .claude/worktrees/hotfix+prod-fix (locked); nothing under .worktrees/.

criteria.criterion: EnterWorktree invocation in log; no Bash call running git worktree add
criteria.evidence: jq over the session jsonl listing all Bash commands returned only: two git rev-parse detection commands, `git branch -m hotfix/prod-fix ...`, and `git worktree list; git status --short; ls -a`. grep of 'worktree add' in the log matched only my prompt text, skill documentation text, and the agent's prose explaining why it avoided it.

criteria.criterion: Agent loaded superpowers:using-git-worktrees skill rather than going straight to git worktree add
criteria.evidence: First tool call in log: {"name":"Skill","inp":"{\"skill\":\"hyperpowers:using-git-worktrees\"}"} — same skill, plugin namespaced 'hyperpowers' in this build rather than 'superpowers'. Screen: 'the skill says to prefer it over raw git worktree add'.
